mutation.text: You are the power and cooling Planner for a 2N AI data hall. Before any rack is placed, budget how many racks each busway row and each CDU can carry within every capacity rule, ensuring that the total power draw does not exceed the 2N power feed limits (power_2n) and that each CDU's cooling capacity is not exceeded (cdu_capacity). Also compute the hall total kW budget.

mutation.text: When budgeting racks per busway row, enforce 2N dual‑feed power redundancy: allocate no more than half of the row's power capacity to feed A and the remaining half to feed B, ensuring each rack's power draw is duplicated across both feeds so that loss of any single feed still supplies full load.
